task_summary: Create a low-poly stylized pine tree, game-ready, for a forest scatter system.

penalties.issue: Severe deep trunk-foliage intersection (class 5) at 8 contacts, spanning Silhouette and Materials beyond Geometry's weight
penalties.rationale: Category deductions (~0.8 combined) understate a class-5 fault; penalty prices the cross-category severity without re-charging the Geometry deduction.

problems.issue: Crown is radially symmetric: 8 identical evenly-spaced masses around the trunk axis
problems.evidence: OBSERVED: mirrored outline and equal spacing in the 3/4 render; INFERRED: array/duplicate placement
problems.likely_cause: radial duplicate placement of a single foliage block
problems.recommended_fix: Delete 3 of 8 masses; cluster survivors in 2-3 lobes; jitter yaw +/-20-40deg, tilt +/-5-15deg; scale 0.6-1.4x continuous with one hero lobe; move upper-right mass 0.25-0.4 crown radii outward

problems.issue: Crown masses penetrate the trunk deeply (class 5) at 8 contacts; 2 upper masses detached
problems.evidence: OBSERVED: visible cone-through-trunk passage on the left edge and near the tip
problems.likely_cause: concentric ring placement with no contact pass
problems.recommended_fix: Move each mass outward to shallow class-3 contact; add branch stubs at the 5 most visible contacts

problems.issue: Crown too narrow: height:crown about 4.5:1 vs reference range 3-3.5:1
problems.evidence: REFERENCE-SUPPORTED (mature pine photo set) for the range; OBSERVED for the 4.5:1 measurement ratio
problems.recommended_fix: Widen crown ~25% at the lower whorl; keep total height

problems.issue: Single flat crown value; lit and shaded lobes indistinguishable in greyscale
problems.evidence: OBSERVED: greyscale collapse of the crown into one mass
problems.likely_cause: one shared material, no value variation
problems.recommended_fix: Assign a second crown material ~15% darker to 2 of 5 lobes

what_is_working: Trunk taper and trunk/crown thickness relationship plausible and on-style
Verification-quality capture: 70% frame fill, neutral lighting
required_changes: Delete 3 of 8 crown masses; cluster survivors; jitter yaw +/-20-40deg and tilt +/-5-15deg; continuous scale range 0.6-1.4x with one hero lobe
Move all crown masses to shallow class-3 trunk contact; add branch stubs at 5 visible contacts
Widen crown ~25% at lower whorl (target ~3.2:1 height:crown)
Add a second crown material ~15% darker on 2 of 5 lobes

references_used.title: Mature lodgepole-type pine photo set
references_used.used_for: silhouette, height:crown ratio range 3-3.5:1, ragged crown outline

confidence_notes: Level 1 only: crown backside, exact penetration depth, and topology are not verifiable from one render.
